column4: dialect-gated per SUBTEST: a registeredBackends test, so it runs one subtest per dialect and mysql and mssql skip in these PostgreSQL-only jobs while postgres RUNS -- two, not three. Measured by name with only CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES set, not derived from a delta: go test ./engine/ -run TestARetryOfAnAlreadyCommittedFlushIsNotAFenceLoss -count=1 -json reports exactly TestARetryOfAnAlreadyCommittedFlushIsNotAFenceLoss/mysql and /mssql. Guards the safety argument for retrying the DIRECT flush path at all (cleat#1717): an attempt whose INSERT committed but whose acknowledgement was lost replays as zero affected rows, and afterFencedInsert answers zero rows by asking Heartbeat whether the fence still holds rather than assuming it was lost. Before #1734 the direct path never retried, so this property was never exercised. It has to run on all three because insertEventSQL and its zero-rows handling are written per dialect, so a postgres-only run cannot vouch for the other two -- and a lost acknowledgement reported as ErrFenceLost would mark a durable step unpersisted.
